versions.changelog:
- Initial release of base-l2-agent-kit: an MCP server for Base L2 DeFi tools.
- Provides wallet management, token swaps, liquidity provision, price feeds, contract interaction, and flash loan arbitrage.
- Includes tools for wallet balances, transaction history, sending tokens, DEX swaps, liquidity management, token/gas price checks, contract calls, gas estimation, and flash loans.
- Supports environment-based configuration for RPC URL and wallet management.
- Released under the MIT license.
